scenario: 今天具身赛道的主线是怎么把通用机器人模型评准、用好。RoboColosseum 在多地的真实机器人上让模型两两盲测，发现排名随机器人和任务变化很大，RoboScope Kit 则把仿真评测加速了好几倍。在控制和数据一侧，HITCH 让视觉语言模型通过一套接口操控人形机器人，OopsieRecover 研究少量纠正怎样推广到新场景，MoMaSplat 解决底盘位置偏了策略就失效的问题，Social Humanoid 让人形机器人学会和人配合。

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.authors: Tan Sang Nguyen, Yi Ru Wang, Shailesh Shailesh, Gang Yang, Jiamo Hu, Jianuo Jiang, Haoquan Fang, Zhongzheng Ren, Zhongyi Luo, Ian Chong, Aaron Tung, Santiago Pravisani, Minghui Lin, Yao Mo, Ishneet Singh, Benjamin Tee, Harold Soh, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Dieter Fox, David Hsu, Haoming Song, Maxime Ellerbach, Thomas Wolf, Pepijn Kooijmans, Ruijie He, Michael Cho, Jiafei Duan
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks relia
papers.summary: 给通用机器人策略排名，最大的麻烦是真机实验很难复现：同一个任务换个场地、换个摆法，结果就不一样。RoboColosseum 在多地的真实机器人上，让五个机器人基础模型和三个通用的前沿大模型 agent 在四种机器人上两两盲测，两个模型面对相同的本地条件。前沿 agent 能追平专门为机器人训练的模型，但所有系统都很难可靠完成开放环境里的任务。只看成败会漏掉信息：人形机器人 G1 上没有策略做成任何一个任务，但每个任务预设了若干项完成条件，进度就是做成了其中多大比例，各策略的平均进度仍从 13.3% 到 23.2% 拉开了差距。==同一批模型在不同机器人上的排名只有微弱的一致性==，所以评估要多机型、看进度。

papers.title: HITCH: Teaching a Vision-Language Model to Operate a Humanoid through a Whole-Body Harness
papers.authors: Qingzhou Lu, Chenxin Liu, Xinming Wang, Liu Cao, Yanjiang Guo, Mengdi Xu, Jianyu Chen
papers.abstract: Enabling vision-language models (VLMs) to control humanoid robots requires both reliable whole-body interfaces and knowledge of how to use the body that carries over across tasks. We present HITCH (Harness Interfaces To Command Humanoids), a harness in which perception returns the 3D position of any point the VLM selects in its image, and execution turns commands for the pelvis, torso, hands, walking, and gaze into whole-body motion with a learned tracker. We find that both measuring the scene and executing commands accurately raise task success. We then fine-tune a VLM on trajectories in which teacher policies solve five base tasks through HITCH, so that it learns how to operate the humanoid. Without task-specific trajectories, the fine-tuned model completes 51% of SIMPLE episodes and 42.5% of HumanoidArena episodes, and adding five trajectories per SIMPLE task raises its SIMPLE success to 95%. On a real G1, it carries a box and walks to a goal without real training data.
papers.summary: 让 VLM 直接操控人形机器人有两道难关：模型要从图像里知道物体在哪、有多远，机器人还要把“手伸到那里”“转一下躯干”这类高层指令稳稳做成全身动作。HITCH 给 VLM 配了一套接口：VLM 在图像上点一个位置，系统返回这个点的三维坐标；VLM 对骨盆、躯干、双手、行走和视线下指令，再由一个学出来的控制器转成全身动作。实验发现，测得准、执行得准，任务成功率都会明显上升。再用教师策略通过这套接口解五个基础任务的轨迹去微调 VLM，没有用 SIMPLE 任务的轨迹，它在 SIMPLE 上的成功率也从 3.3% 升到 51.1%。在真机 G1 上，它没用任何真机数据就搬箱子成功了 13 次（共 20 次）。

papers.title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
papers.authors: Kenneth Llontop, Cherie Ho, Dylan Zhou, Anuva Banwasi, Priya Sundaresan, Carlota Parés-Morlans, Jeannette Bohg
papers.abstract: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the str
papers.summary: 家里或办公室的路常被椅子、玩具、推车挡住，机器人得判断哪些东西可以推开、哪些必须绕开：同样是推车，空的能推，装着易碎玻璃器皿的就不能碰。MessyNav 不靠仿真里训练，也不需要人给每个场景写说明。它先让视觉语言模型结合图像和上下文，判断每个物体是可以推扫、拿起还是应该避开，再据此规划动作。在 15 个真实场景里，它走到目标且没有不安全操作的比例是 67%，把判断和规划放进同一个提示里的做法只有 40%。分开做的好处在于，物体能不能动要先看清它的状态，比如上面堆的东西稳不稳，再谈怎么走。

papers.title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
papers.authors: Vongani H. Maluleke, James Ni, Kie Horiuchi, Lea Wilken, Jiahui Lei, Evonne Ng, Roei Herzig, Jitendra Malik, Trevor Darrell, Angjoo Kanazawa
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. We apply this procedure across five motion-capture datasets to produce a
papers.summary: 现有人形机器人大多按单人训练，没法和身边的人配合：对方伸手拥抱或击掌时，它不会预判，也不会跟着调整。Social Humanoid 让一台宇树 G1 根据人的动作生成配合动作，比如拥抱，或打完招呼后一起合影。它分两层：上层模型把人和机器人的动作转成同一套离散编码，据此生成机器人的回应，人被挡住时还能接着预测对方的动作；下层控制器负责在机器人身上执行。训练数据来自把五个人与人互动的动作捕捉数据集迁移到机器人身上，得到 260 小时的人与人形机器人互动数据。仿真里生成的动作有 90% 到 100% 能被下层控制器完整执行，真机上每个场景的成功率与仿真一致。

papers.title: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
papers.authors: Arpit Bahety, Skand Peri, Sriniket Ambatipudi, Chen Xu, Haruki Nishimura, Masha Itkina, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations a
papers.summary: 机器人操作大模型部署后会出错，比如碰撞或掉东西。常见做法是让人接管示范纠正再微调，但学到的只是在这个画面下就做这个动作，场景一变就不灵，往往要几十到上百次干预。OopsieRecover 想让模型从少数几次纠正里学到错在哪、该怎么避开。它让视觉语言模型根据场景、接管前后的动作和一句口头说明，提出几种可能的原因，再拿所有纠正去检验，留下最能解释它们的那一种。这个原因被写成一条规则：什么时候生效，以及此时哪种动作要扣分，比如放杯子时把杯子倾斜。部署时原模型先生成多个候选动作，选扣分最低的。在 CoffeeMug 任务的新场景里，只用 8 次纠正成功率就到 84%，用三倍纠正量微调的 HG-DAgger 只有 28%。

papers.title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Sateesh Kumar, Arnav Balaji, Arpit Bahety, Skand Peri, Georgios Pavlakos, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.abstract: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the
papers.summary: 移动操作机器人很难每次都站在示范时的位置上干活，而模仿学习的策略对相机视角很敏感，底盘位置稍有偏差就可能失效。已有方法用新视角合成来扩充示范，但只能处理静态场景，物体被抓起移动之后就没法重新渲染，而这恰好是最关键的阶段。MoMaSplat 利用示范采集时本来就有的多视角画面，分别重建静态场景和被操作的物体，再从没见过的底盘位置渲染整段操作，并把动作按新位置换算，生成合成示范。真实任务测试把底盘放在没见过的位置上，用它生成的示范训练出的策略平均成功率是 37%。最强基线只有 17%，不做扩充更低，只有 6%。

papers.title: Which Physical Tactile Cues Matter for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning? A Controlled Real-Robot Study
papers.authors: Xuhao Qin, Xiyan Huang, Haoyu Dong, Xi Zhang, Chenxi Xiao
papers.abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors capture multiple aspects of physical interaction within a single image stream, including contact appearance, geometry, indentation depth, and tangential deformation. However, existing visuo-tactile policies often directly process tactile observations as images, making it difficult to determine which physical cues contribute to policy learning. This paper presents a controlled real-robot study that compares physically interpretable tactile signals using the LeRobot platform, enhanced with our visuo-tactile perception system. From the same tactile stream, we derive tactile RGB images, normal/depth maps, and marker-flow fields, representing contact appearance, geometry, and tangential deformation, respectively. Using identical task demonstrations and the same policy backbone, we evaluate the individual and combined contributions of these tactile cues. We further compare tactile encoders and visuo-tactile fusion strategies. Evaluation across 720 real-robot tria
papers.summary: 视触觉传感器通过一块弹性体的形变成像，同一路图像里混着接触外观、几何形状和切向形变几种信息，但已有策略通常直接把触觉图当普通图像输入，没人说得清到底哪种信息在起作用。这项研究在真机上做了控制变量对比：从同一路触觉图像里分出外观图、法向图和深度图、以及弹性体表面标记点的位移流场，用相同的示范和同样的策略骨干，单独或组合使用。在真机试验中，加入触觉后总成功率从 57.8% 提到 78.9%。单个信号里，标记点位移流场最有用，成功率 74.4%，在维持已建立的接触阶段作用尤其大。做触觉模仿学习时，按物理信号拆开分别编码，比把触觉图当 RGB 直接输入更好。

papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.authors: Hanqing Wang, Zhaotian Cai, Ruichuan An, Bohan Zeng, Tao Zhang, Yilin Chen, Xu Jiang, Kaiquan Chen, Chongyang Wu, Haoran Li, Fan Yang, Mingan Lin, Wentao Zhang, Zenan Zhou, Youzheng Wu, Xiaodong He
papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future
papers.summary: 想让根据图像和指令直接输出动作的 VLA 模型懂物理动力学，一个办法是接视频世界模型预测未来画面，但在线生成视频会给控制回路带来很高延迟。PDRVLA 只在训练时借用它。模型里有一个轻量模块，用一组可学习的查询向量从中间层特征里取出固定数量的物理 token。训练时让这些 token 预测未来的 RGB、深度和光流特征，也就是装下未来画面会怎么变，同时把这些 token 交给冻结的预训练视频世界模型当条件，让它去还原未来画面，还原的误差也用来训练这个模块。部署时不再生成视频，动作模块直接把这些 token 和最后一层特征一起使用。它在 LIBERO 上的任务成功率是 99.3%。消融显得克制：加入世界模型监督，未来特征预测的误差只相对降低了 1.32%。

papers.title: RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation
papers.authors: Deng-Ke Wu, Yifan Jin, Yida Yang, Lei Qian, Zhaoye Zhou, Hongru Zhang, Kai Ye, Shuyuan Hu, Yiran Mao, Zewei Ye, Bo Zhao
papers.abstract: Simulation benchmarks are the standard way to compare robot policies, but each benchmark brings its own evaluator, observation layout, and action convention, and evaluation is slow: 500 RoboTwin Easy episodes with one simulator and one model on one GPU take 359.7 minutes. Profiling the official StarVLA evaluator shows that simulation occupies CPU cores while the GPU averages 14.3% utilization. RoboScope Kit wraps each model once in a Python class called a Policy, and each benchmark once in an adapter around the benchmark's own evaluator, so the benchmark's rules and scoring stay unchanged. Scheduling runs simulator workers and Policy replicas as separate pools, sizes both from measured probes, and shards work deterministically across GPU instances; runtime optimization renders only the observations an action-chunk Policy reads. Adapters cover six benchmark families. On LIBERO-Long with a StarVLA checkpoint on one 48 GiB RTX 4090, the concurrency search selects twelve simulator workers
papers.summary: VLA 的仿真评测很慢，主要是资源没用满：在单卡上跑五百个 RoboTwin Easy 回合要近六个小时，因为仿真占满 CPU 核，而 GPU 平均利用率只有 14.3%。RoboScope Kit 把每个模型包成一个统一的 Policy 类，再给每个基准套一层适配器，统一两边交换的观测和动作格式，基准自己的规则和评分不动。然后把仿真进程和模型副本分成两个池子，先短时试跑不同数量的组合，选出能跑通且最快的那组，再把任务确定性地分到多块 GPU。在 LIBERO-Long 上，这样比官方 StarVLA 评测快 4.45 倍，成功率相当。换到 RoboTwin Easy 并用四块 GPU，评测速度是单卡基线的 25.04 倍，成功结果完全一致。

papers.title: A new gear: How startups are advancing robotics with Google AI
papers.abstract: Pioneering robotics startups are leveraging Google Cloud's unified infrastructure and frontier AI models to accelerate the shift from digital intelligence to real-world physical deployment.
papers.summary: 做具身系统的团队正在把它拆成两层：云端的具身推理模型负责空间推理、任务规划和进度跟踪，机器人本体上的轻量 VLA 或小模型负责实时电机控制。谷歌云在一篇介绍机器人创业公司的文章里描述了这种架构，并说云上的算力主要用于仿真、训练和机队调度。案例包括人形机器人 Apollo 接入 Gemini Robotics 模型，以及 Dyna Robotics 用谷歌云 GPU 集群训练模型，并且每天向生产现场发布更新。这是一篇产品宣传性质的文章，对做具身系统的人，参考价值主要在云端规划加本地执行的分工。
